description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core action filter called ValidatorActionFilter that validates the model state before executing the action, and returns a JSON error response if the model is invalid.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core action filter that intercepts action execution to validate model state and returns a JSON-formatted error response if validation fails.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks the validity of the model state before an action executes, and returns a 422 JSON error response if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: A placeholder method required by the IActionFilter interface; currently does nothing post action execution.
